subject.name: Advisory locks for posting serialization
subject.summary: Serialize concurrent postings per account with pg_advisory_xact_lock(account_id) instead of SELECT FOR UPDATE
subject.description: Decision: concurrent postings to the same account are serialized with Postgres transaction-scoped advisory locks keyed by account_id. Rejected: SELECT FOR UPDATE (deadlocks when two transfers touch the same two accounts in opposite order), a single-writer queue (adds latency). Synonyms: locking strategy, posting serialization, deadlock fix, pg_advisory_xact_lock.

operations.description: Decided by Priya after the May deadlock incident; alternatives: SELECT FOR UPDATE (deadlocked under contention), single-writer queue (too slow).
posting engine in ledger-api applies the lock

subject.name: Migrate notifier email from SendGrid to SES in Q4
subject.summary: Proposal: replace the SendGrid email adapter with Amazon SES in Q4 2026
subject.description: Proposed decision to move statement emails from SendGrid to Amazon SES for cost and deliverability; keeps the email adapter interface. Synonyms: email provider migration, SES, sendgrid replacement.

operations.description: Proposed by Marco: SendGrid cost and deliverability; SES via the same email adapter interface. Not yet accepted.
